description: Percorsi pedonali o ciclabili urbani (Art.37 POC riferito al territorio dell'ex Comune di Tavarnelle Val di Pesa) - Comune di Barberino Tavarnelle is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoserver.055055.it. In the 1:2,000 scale maps, some pedestrian or cycle paths are identified in order to define an alternative mobility to the car in urban areas. They integrate with the territorial cycling network. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Pedestrian or urban cycle paths (Art.37 POC referring to the territory of the former Municipality of Tavarnelle Val di P" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include pianificazione, geodata, percorsi ciclabli, percorsi pedonali, Piano Operativo. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
